title: A Harbor for the Atlas
author: Jude Hartwell
blurb: Tamsin Sandoval, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the census taker asks one question too many, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the ice breaks on the river.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
